Method of Attack: Malicious SPAM email with password protected encrypted Word document attachment containing embedded VBScript files that download and install the Ursnif keylogger
VBScript launches a script that downloads a DLL to %AppData% folder and installs Ursnif keylogger
DLL copied to %UserProfile%\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\CryplAPI\aeevtall.dll and autorun created to load DLL on login
Ursnif records keystrokes, programs opened, files created, clipboard data, and saves logs in %Temp% folder with .bin extension
Logs are archives sent to a TOR server controlled by malware developers
Attack Vector: SPAM email with malicious password protected Word document attachment
User interaction to open attachment and run embedded VBScript
Indicators of Compromise: Log files in %Temp% folder with random names ending in .bin (e.g., ja71.bin)
